note: Golden outputs of DesignTokens, regenerated by DesignTokensGoldenTest with WPMGR_WRITE_FIXTURES=1 and never edited by hand. Each case holds a design (the input) and every value the class answers for it. A number the compile path writes as text is recorded as that text: line_height, letter_spacing and the overlay opacity are strings (a point for the decimal mark, at most four decimals, no trailing zero; the opacity at most two), and every other number is a JSON integer, so the file holds no float and reads the same under any float setting. A colour is an upper-case #RRGGBB, or rgba(r,g,b,a) with no spaces and the alpha without trailing zeros. A null is a value the class answers as none: a family for the design font system, a line height or letter spacing a style does not set, the overlay none. "ratios" is the number each ratio name stands for, as text. "type_scale" is the pixel size of each text style for every ratio name and every base size from 15 to 20. "hover" and "alpha" are single calls of the two static functions (hover takes an upper-case #RRGGBB, alpha takes that and a percent from 0 to 100). "refused" is calls the class refuses with an InvalidArgumentException; a twin refuses them too.
